## Pull request overview

Adds a new canvas-based **FlowDesigner** to `@object-ui/plugin-workflow` and introduces the corresponding spec v3.0.9-aligned flow graph types in `@object-ui/types`, with registry wiring, tests, and roadmap updates.

**Changes:**
- Added Flow Designer protocol types (nodes/edges/executors/boundaries/versioning/execution overlay/BPMN export result) and re-exported them from `@object-ui/types`.
- Implemented and registered `FlowDesigner` (`type: 'flow-designer'`) in `@object-ui/plugin-workflow`, including canvas interactions, property panel, execution overlay, and BPMN export.
- Added FlowDesigner test suite and updated `ROADMAP.md` to mark Flow Designer items complete.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 13 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/workflow.ts | Introduces Flow Designer type model (nodes, edges, execution, versions, schema). |
| packages/types/src/index.ts | Re-exports new workflow Flow Designer types from the package entrypoint. |
| packages/plugin-workflow/src/index.tsx | Exports FlowDesigner and registers it in ComponentRegistry with schema inputs metadata. |
| packages/plugin-workflow/src/FlowDesigner.tsx | Implements the FlowDesigner canvas editor UI, interactions, BPMN export, and panels. |
| packages/plugin-workflow/src/__tests__/FlowDesigner.test.tsx | Adds component-level tests for rendering and key interactions. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks Flow Designer roadmap section/items as complete. |
</details>
The inline `style={{ fontSize: ... }}` on SVG `<text>` duplicates the Tailwind `text-[10px]` / `text-[9px]` classes. Dropping the inline style reduces redundancy and keeps styling in one place.
`Plus` is imported from `lucide-react` but never used. Removing unused imports avoids eslint warnings and keeps the bundle smaller.

FlowDesignerSchema includes `onSave?: string` (action name), but the component registry inputs don’t expose `onSave`, and the component implementation uses only a function prop. If FlowDesigner is intended to be used via schema-driven rendering, consider adding `onSave` to registry inputs and implementing action dispatch, or remove the schema field to avoid an undocumented/unsupported contract.
```suggestion
      { name: 'executionSteps', type: 'code', label: 'Execution Steps' },
      { name: 'onSave', type: 'string', label: 'On Save Action' },
```

BPMN XML is built via string interpolation without XML escaping (e.g., `title`, node ids/labels, and `conditionExpression`). If any of these contain characters like `&`, `<`, `"`, the exported XML becomes invalid and could be abused when opened by downstream tooling. Escape attribute values (or build XML with a minimal serializer) before emitting.

`rect` is computed but never used, and the `void rect;` workaround is a code smell. Either use `rect` for coordinate calculations or remove both the `getBoundingClientRect()` call and the `void rect` line to keep the drop handler clean.

The registry metadata exposes `showMinimap`, but FlowDesigner currently doesn’t render any minimap UI. Either implement minimap support or remove `showMinimap` from the ComponentRegistry inputs so schema authors don’t configure a no-op property.

Using `transform: scale(...)` for zoom won’t increase the element’s layout size, so the scroll container may not let users pan to the full zoomed canvas (parts can become unreachable when zoomed in). Consider adjusting the canvas wrapper dimensions based on zoom (or use a pan/zoom approach that updates scroll extents) so scrolling matches the visual size.

The “Import BPMN (drag & drop)” button has no click handler and there’s no drop zone logic to ingest a file, so it’s a dead control in the UI. Either wire it up (e.g., hidden file input + parse) or remove/disable it until import is implemented to avoid confusing users.
```suggestion
                <Button
                  size="icon"
                  variant="ghost"
                  className="h-7 w-7"
                  title="Import BPMN is not available yet"
                  disabled
                >
```

`handleSave` only calls the React prop `onSave`, but the schema also defines `schema.onSave` as a string action name (and the component is registered in `ComponentRegistry`). If FlowDesigner is intended to be driven purely by schema in the renderer, the save action will currently be a no-op. Consider supporting `schema.onSave` by dispatching an action/event (or remove `onSave` from the schema and registry to keep the API consistent).
